svg.title: Where Straza sits between identity, agents and tools
svg.desc: People, AI agents and roles arrive from the IGA over SCIM 2.0, and people sign in through the identity provider over OIDC. Agents on a machine are decided locally by straza against a signed snapshot. MCP clients reach tools only through the strazad gateway. strazad sends calls that need approval to approvers, injects credentials toward MCP servers, and streams the hash-chained audit record to a SIEM. Each decision is allowed, denied with a reason, or needs approval from a person. Three example actions are drawn in the colors of their outcomes: a denied action stops at straza with a reason, an action that needs approval goes through strazad to the approvers, and an allowed MCP call runs through the gateway to its server.
